prompt.project_info: Create a high-fashion chess editorial with dramatic studio light and a commanding fictional adult subject.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult fictional woman with pale skin, slicked-back platinum hair, smoky eye makeup, bold red lipstick, oversized black blazer, crisp white high-collar blouse with secure coverage, opaque white patterned tights, pearl choker, white folding fan, and generic silver geometric brooch.
prompt.composition_elements: 9:16 portrait on a giant black-and-white marble chessboard, oversized white marble pieces surrounding the subject, seated comfortably with legs naturally crossed, fan held near the torso, direct gaze.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dramatic high-contrast overhead and side light, strong sculptural shadows, black-white palette with red lip accent, crisp marble and fabric texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Sharp high-resolution editorial photography, deep focus, realistic skin, fabric, marble, fan and hands, no text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: High-fashion 9:16 editorial portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman with slicked-back platinum hair, smoky eyes, bold red lipstick, oversized black blazer, secure white high-collar blouse, opaque white patterned tights, pearl choker, white folding fan and generic silver brooch, seated comfortably with legs crossed on a giant black-and-white marble chessboard among oversized pieces, direct gaze, dramatic high-contrast studio light, crisp photorealistic texture, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, deep neckline, transparent blouse, sexualized spread pose, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, religious insignia, watermark, logo, text, plastic skin, extra fingers, deformed

assets.name: chess queen fashion reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Preserve chessboard, blazer, blouse, platinum hair, fan, marble pieces, and dramatic composition; keep identity and accessory details replaceable.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the reference image. Keep fashion silhouette and chess symbolism consistent, use secure coverage and a natural crossed-leg pose, and replace any real identity or religious symbol.

changes: Clarified adult fictional identity, replaced deep neckline and sheer styling with secure coverage, changed spread pose to crossed legs, and made brooch generic.
policy_review.notes: Chess editorial is non-graphic and nonsexual.
